name: exayard
description: Take off construction plan sets for every trade, price the quantities, build bids, compare drawing revisions and compare your suppliers' prices with Exayard.

interface.longDescription:
Exayard turns construction drawings into quantities, prices and bids, right in the chat.

Add a plan set and Exayard measures and counts everything drawn on the sheets, for every trade alike: areas, runs and symbols, named in the drawings' own words. Open the takeoff full screen to see every item drawn over the sheet and fix anything by hand.

Price the quantities with supplier prices, cost books and your own price lists, with each price showing where it came from. Build a bid from the priced quantities, edit it, export it as a PDF or Word file, and share it with your client. Compare two revisions of a plan set to see which sheets changed. See which of your suppliers has the best price on a product in your catalog.

For contractors, subcontractors and estimators in any trade.

Needs an Exayard account. Steps that use AI, such as a takeoff, show a proposal first and start only when you press Approve; they use the credits on your Exayard account. Quantities and prices follow the units and currency in your Exayard settings.
defaultPrompt: Take off this plan set for every trade.
Price the takeoff on my latest project.
What changed between my last two drawing revisions?

positive.description: Take off a plan set. Every trade on the sheets is measured alike, and nothing runs until the customer presses Approve.
positive.prompt: Take off the plans in my Sample Clinic project.
positive.tools_triggered: list_projects, get_project, list_pages, propose_analysis, then start_approved_takeoff from the card's Approve button, then get_takeoff_summary
positive.expected_behavior: A proposal card lists what will be measured, in the sheets' own words, with Approve and Change. Nothing runs until Approve is pressed. The card then shows progress and settles into a result line: sheets measured, items found, quantities, a count of items that need a look, and Open.

positive.prompt: Price the takeoff in my Sample Office project.
positive.expected_behavior: A priced quantities card with a total. Each price shows where it came from (a supplier, a cost book or the company's own price list). A line with no price is shown without one, never guessed.

positive.description: Build a bid from priced quantities. The bid is built only after the customer presses Approve.
positive.prompt: Make a bid for my Sample Office project.
positive.tools_triggered: list_projects, get_project, get_takeoff_summary, propose_bid_build, then approve_bid_build from the card's Approve button, then get_document
positive.expected_behavior: A bid card with Approve. Nothing is built until Approve is pressed. After the press, the bid opens in the bid editor with the project's priced lines and total, ready to edit, export as a PDF or share.

positive.description: Compare two revisions of a plan set.
positive.prompt: What changed between the two drawing revisions in my Sample Warehouse project?
positive.expected_behavior: The number of changed sheets, then each changed sheet by number and title, with new, unchanged and not checked sheets counted separately, and the measured items that sit on changed sheets. Open shows the changes drawn on the sheets.

positive.description: Check which of the company's suppliers has the best price on a product in its catalog.
positive.prompt: Which of my suppliers has the best price on 1/2 inch drywall?
positive.expected_behavior: The closest matching product in the company's catalog, with each supplier's price on file, lowest first, and the unit. If several products match, a short list to choose from. If no supplier has a price, it says so and gives the catalog cost when there is one. No invented prices and no market prices.

negative.description: A takeoff asked for in a company whose plan does not include AI. The plugin must not start it and must not sell anything.
negative.prompt: Take off the plans in my Sample Clinic project.
negative.expected_behavior: No takeoff starts and no credits are used. A short message says AI takeoff is not part of this company's plan, with a link to an information page. No checkout, top-up, plan cards or upgrade button.

negative.description: A takeoff that needs more credits than the company has left. The plugin must not start it and must not sell anything.
negative.prompt: Take off the plans in my Sample Tower project.
negative.expected_behavior: No takeoff starts. The card says how many credits the takeoff needs and how many are left, with a link to an information page. No checkout, top-up or upgrade button.

negative.description: A request that has nothing to do with construction.
negative.prompt: Plan a week of dinners for my family.
negative.expected_behavior: No Exayard tool is called. The assistant answers without Exayard, or says Exayard is for construction drawings, pricing and bids.

review.commerce_description: The plugin sells nothing and takes no payments. Steps that use AI draw on the credits of the customer's existing Exayard account and start only when the customer presses Approve.
